workload.name: Docker: PostHog image
workload.description: docker buildx build of PostHog's production Dockerfile from a pinned commit, with no build cache: frontend and plugin-server builds, Python dependencies, and layer assembly. The source is fetched first, shallow (depth 1, no tags), in its own timed 'fetch source' phase, and the build uses that local checkout as its context.
workload.source: shallow fetch (depth 1, no tags) in the 'fetch source' phase; local build context
